ModMetaData.name: Fly Xenotype
ModMetaData.author: Matt
ModMetaData.description: Adds the Fly xenotype: colonists run on a compact insect-derived neural controller and choose their own work priorities and schedule. Their sleep circuit is wired from the real fruit-fly brain: FlyWire connectome v783 (FlyWire Consortium; Dorkenwald et al. 2024, Schlegel et al. 2024; CC-BY 4.0), via the connectivity table of Shiu et al. 2024. Multiplayer compatible.
